literal_meaning: নাক উঁচু করে চলা (nose held high)
figurative_meaning_bn: উন্নাসিক; নাক উঁচু করে চলে এমন লোক
figurative_meaning_en: Snobbish; a person who walks with their nose held high
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা নাকুয়া লোক, সবাইকে তুচ্ছ ভাবে।
নাকুয়া ভাবে কথা বললে কেউ সম্মান করবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a snobbish person who looks down on everyone.
Walking with a snobbish attitude won't earn you respect.
note: Derived from physical posture implying superiority, common in colloquial Bengali.
